reviews.title: unacceptable offensive ads
reviews.text: I have had this app for years. The in-app ads always bugged me, but lately they became worse than just irksome— started to get streams of offensive material which I can’t name because the review won’t post if I do. Don’t know if that ’s intentional or it somehow got highjacked- totally unacceptable either way. Deleted it.

reviews.title: Spyware
reviews.text: Read the fine print on this app. Not only does it track many things about you, but it sells all of it to other companies. They’re making money on you while you’re giving your private information away to them for free.
